svg.text: A section nobody has amended looks the same whether it was deliberately left alone or never reopened. Its neighbours tell you which.
Each dot is one in-force section of CFR Title 12, plotted against the median age of the rest of its part. Axes split at the title median, 9.8 years.
Both axes share one range, so the diagonal is a true 45°: on it, a section is exactly as stale as its neighbourhood.
years since this section was amended
median age of the rest of its part
they reopened the part and left this alone
nobody has looked at this neighbourhood
the one rule here they keep having to re-fix
774 sections (32%) sit exactly on the diagonal because their whole part was amended in one action. They carry no within-part signal; this inflates
FOSSIL and LIVE, and cannot affect SETTLED or PROBLEM CHILD, which are off-diagonal by definition.
Compared to the median of the OTHER dated sections in the part; 53 sole dated sections are excluded for having no neighbourhood.
Source: eCFR full-text API, snapshot 2026-09-01. In-force sections carrying their own source note.
